Eighty of them. Stood up in a perfect ring.

Today is the shortest day of the year.
When the sun touches the tallest stone...
you'll know who really built Stonehenge.

They tell you: rope, wooden sledges, and muscle.
From a quarry twenty-five kilometres away.
But the big stones are not the problem.
